Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant proteinuria, hematuria, leukocyturia, nitrites, bacteria, and markedly elevated E. coli in culture, consistent with a urinary tract infection, likely complicated. Low specific gravity may indicate impaired urine concentrating ability. Recommend prompt clinical evaluation and initiation of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
